## PresenceDeclinedError class

Thrown when a required fresh, per-use human presence action was explicitly declined by the human (e.g. a biometric or touch prompt was cancelled).

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class PresenceDeclinedError extends VaultError 
```
**Extends:** [VaultError](./vaultkeeper.vaulterror.md)

## Remarks

Distinct from [AuthorizationDeniedError](./vaultkeeper.authorizationdeniederror.md)<!-- -->, which signals a token or capability rejection, and from [PresenceTimeoutError](./vaultkeeper.presencetimeouterror.md)<!-- -->, which signals the device was present but no action happened in time. A declined presence action means the human was asked and said no.
